description.text: The major is to train professionals with basic knowledge in geographic information systems and mapping, remote sensing technology, space positioning technology, spatial data processing technology, computer hardware and software applications, computer communication, software development, and other computer-science and technology, who are capable of scientific research or teaching work in the colleges and universities or research institutions, and geographic information systems and related research, development and management in the field of communications network planning and management, urban construction, regional planning, resources, environment, transportation, population, housing, land, infrastructure, planning management and computer applications. The major takes geographic information systems as the foundation, closely linked with computer technology and information technology by giving full play to the advantage in the disciplines of information technology of the university, and it develops itself into an interdisciplinary. Graduate have solid knowledge in geography and cartography with good knowledge of computer science and technology, and strong capacity of geographic information system software applications and development, so that they meet the job requirements in communications, Computer, enterprises information technology, and city digitalization.

duration.text: The Geographic Information System at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
